Python 3.11 or newer is required.

## Troubleshooting

**`PDFInfoNotInstalledError: Unable to get page count`**: the page renderer needs the poppler utilities. Install them with `brew install poppler` (macOS) or `apt install poppler-utils` (Debian/Ubuntu), then retry.
